title: Chronic Cellars
specs: Wines made with character and playful labels.
Winemaker Kip Lorenzetti specializes in California Central Coast blends.
gap: No tasting room or onsite experiences available.
blurb: Chronic Cellars produces wines using grapes from Paso Robles, focusing on unique blends crafted by winemaker Kip Lorenzetti. The winery emphasizes character and creativity in their wines and labels. Their tasting room is permanently closed, but wines are available online and in stores.
extraNote: Shipments occur via UPS Monday through Thursday with overnight shipping in California; delivery 3-14 business days out of state. · Orders placed after midnight PST ship the next available shipping day. · Flat rate shipping for 6-11 bottles is $40, for 12-24 bottles is $45; 2-day shipping $35 for 6-11 bottles, $50 for 12-24 bottles. · No flat rate shipping to Hawaii; club members get 50% off 2-day shipping for 6+ bottles to Hawaii. · No longer shipping to Alaska and some states shown in gray on their map.
